title: VoC Engine — Channel Field Mapping v1.0
description: Official mapping of raw channel payload fields to UEC (Universal Event Contract) standard fields. Priority order: first matching field wins.

uec_fields.text: The complaint or message body — passed to NLP pipeline for analysis.
uec_fields.customer_id: Raw customer identifier — SHA-256 hashed before storage (POPIA compliance).
uec_fields.timestamp: Event timestamp — ISO 8601 UTC. Defaults to ingest time if absent.
uec_fields.customer_arr: Customer Annual Recurring Revenue in ZAR — used for crisis score weighting.
uec_fields.sentiment_polarity: Pre-computed polarity [-1.0, 1.0] — overrides NLP if supplied by source.
uec_fields.sentiment_confidence: Pre-computed confidence [0.0, 1.0] — overrides NLP if supplied by source.
uec_fields.taxonomy_path: Pre-classified UEC path (Domain.Capability.Theme) — overrides classifier if supplied.

email.description: Inbound support emails — direct from inbox or forwarded via helpdesk.

zendesk.description: Zendesk ticket submissions — description field is the primary text source.

web_form.description: In-product feedback forms and contact-us submissions.

api.description: Programmatic submissions — internal tools, CRM integrations, batch imports.
